claims.quote: Oryzias songkhramensis is a small ricefish known only from the Songkhram River basin in northeastern Thailand and the Mekong drainage in Laos.
Oryzias songkhramensis is a small ricefish known only from the Songkhram River basin in northeastern Thailand and the Mekong drainage in Laos.
Known only from the Songkhram River basin, a tributary of the Mekong system flowing through several provinces of northeastern Thailand, plus parts of the Mekong drainage in central Laos.
